headline: Former BOJ Chief Kuroda Backs Rate Hikes While Ex-Deputy Urges Caution
summary: Former Bank of Japan Governor Haruhiko Kuroda expressed support for further interest rate hikes, while his former deputy urged caution on monetary tightening.
why: Bank of Japan policy normalisation impacts Japanese government bond yields, domestic lending rates, and carry trade dynamics across global foreign exchange markets.

impacts.name: Japanese Banking & Financials
impacts.why: Conflicting central bank commentary creates uncertainty over the pace of future interest rate hikes.

why_moved: Diverging views among monetary policy authorities create uncertainty over Japanese borrowing costs, altering yield curve expectations.
